action_items.description: Add rule: TEST FILE PLACEMENT — ALL test files MUST be placed under the project-root tests/ directory: tests/e2e/, tests/integration/, or tests/unit/. NEVER place test files in product/lead-response/dashboard/tests/ or any subdirectory outside of tests/. After writing a test file, verify the path starts with tests/ before committing. Verification will reject any test file outside tests/ and fail the task.
action_items.reason: 3+ consecutive dev tasks failed in the last 7 days because test files were placed in product/lead-response/dashboard/tests/ instead of tests/. This is a repeated, preventable failure pattern.

action_items.description: Add rule: COMMIT VERIFICATION — Before reporting task completion, run 'git log --oneline HEAD -1' and confirm your commit is present. 'No commits on branch' is the #1 cause of task failure (majority of 45 failures this week). If you have nothing to commit (task was already done, or no changes needed), say so explicitly in your completion report with evidence — do NOT exit silently without committing or explaining.
action_items.reason: 45 dev failures this week. The dominant failure mode is agents spawning, running, then exiting without committing. Adding an explicit self-check step will surface this before verification fails.

action_items.description: Add rule: DEDUP CHECK — Before creating any task, query: SELECT id, status FROM tasks WHERE use_case_id = '<uc_id>' AND agent_id = '<agent>' AND status IN ('done','in_progress','ready') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1. If a recent completed or active task exists for this UC+agent combination, do NOT create a new task — report the existing task ID in your completion report instead.
action_items.reason: Product agent creating duplicate tasks for UCs that already have completed tasks, causing 'Archived: duplicate' failures and wasted compute.
